headline: iPhone Ultra limited supply at launch, may ship later
summary: According to analyst Ming-Chi Kuo, Apple is likely to have very limited supply for iPhone Ultra
details: According to supply chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo, Apple is likely to have very limited supply for iPhone Ultra at its launch. The device may ship slightly later than initially expected.
The limited supply is likely to cause high demand and potentially long wait times for customers.
No official confirmation from Apple has been made regarding the iPhone Ultra's release date or availability.
caption:
Will you be able to get your hands on the new iPhone Ultra?

According to supply chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo, Apple is likely to have very limited supply for iPhone Ultra at its launch. The device may ship slightly later than initially expected.

The limited supply is likely to cause high demand and potentially long wait times for customers.

No official confirmation from Apple has been made regarding the iPhone Ultra's release date or availability.

headline: $3.8 billion lost on Trump's $TRUMP memecoin
summary: Nearly 1 million people lost money on $TRUMP memecoin
details: Nearly 1 million people have lost a total of $3.8 billion after buying President Donald Trump's $TRUMP memecoin, according to cryptocurrency analytics firm Nansen.
The memecoin's value has dropped nearly 98% from its high of $75.35 to $1.69.
Trump announced the memecoin three days before his inauguration in 2025 and previously co-founded a crypto startup, World Liberty Financial.
caption:
Can you believe $3.8 billion was lost on a memecoin?

Nearly 1 million people have lost a total of $3.8 billion after buying President Donald Trump's $TRUMP memecoin, according to cryptocurrency analytics firm Nansen.

The memecoin's value has dropped nearly 98% from its high of $75.35 to $1.69.

Trump announced the memecoin three days before his inauguration in 2025 and previously co-founded a crypto startup, World Liberty Financial.

Source: TechCrunch
